annually bases as

DCS QLI Card Analog Input 3 channel (2,3,4) 4- 
20 mA ,Analog Output 1 channel (5) 4- 20 mA , 2 channel (0,1) digital Input, 2 
channel (6,7) digital Output.

NOTE: The digital 
input /output channel can not be tested in our station because it is Not used , 
The analog input /output used for position feedback and command for control 
valves .

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc

Wear anti static hand probe to avoid electrical 
 choke
Unit must be shutdown.
Digital multi-meter
Digital multi-meter
Hand held radio wave for communication
ma source, ma Tester.
Screw driver, Nut driver, and isolating tape
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU cabinet.
Using cabinet termination identify the location for the desired QLI card.

Using cabinet termination list for each card identify the two I/P wires for 
 the 2nd channel.
Using the screw driver to remove these two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the m a leads to the 1st channel.

Inject 4 m A,8 m A,12 m A,16 m A and 20 m A according to 0 %,25 %,50 %,75% and 
 100% .

Compare the tester reading using radio with the reading in the central control 
 room ( CCR) .

If the reading is OK or within the range ( +0.01m a), repeat steps 1 
 to 5 for channels 3,4 .
Using cabinet termination list identify the 2 output wires for channel 5 .
Using the screw driver remove this tow wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the m A tester leads to channel 5 .

From CCR give command 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% which equals 4m A ,8m A , 12m A 
 , 16m A and 20m A .

Compare the tester reading using radio with the reading in the central control 
 room (CCR) .
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the card.
Remove the m a tester..
Reconnect the wires to terminal strip.
Close the cabinet.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.

Work to be Carried Out
Steps to Prepare for Test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU cabinet.
Using cabinet termination identify the location for the desired QLI card.
Start Test
Using cabinet termination list for each card identify the two I/P wires for 
 the 2nd channel.
Using the screw driver to remove these two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the m a leads to the 1st channel.
Inject 4 m A,8 m A,12 m A,16 m A and 20 m A according to 0 %,25 %,50 %,75% and 
 100% .
Compare the tester reading using radio with the reading in the central control 
 room ( CCR) .
If the reading is OK or within the range ( +0.01m a), repeat steps 1 
 to 5 for channels 3,4 .
Using cabinet termination list identify the 2 output wires for channel 5 .
Using the screw driver remove this tow wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the m A tester leads to channel 5 .
From CCR give command 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% which equals 4m A ,8m A , 12m A 
 , 16m A and 20m A .
Compare the tester reading using radio with the reading in the central control 
 room (CCR) .
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the card.
Return Card to Service
Remove the m a tester..
Reconnect the wires to terminal strip.
Close the cabinet.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
